svg.text: Flow 03 Customer ordering at the kiosk
Swimlane activity diagram · one lane per actor · read top to bottom
Walks up to the kiosk, or
opens it on a phone with
Add the dish to the order
• Sold-out dishes stay on the menu but can't be opened or added; availability updates live while the customer
• “Start over” in the top bar, or the idle reset (Flow 13), empties the order and returns to the welcome screen at
any point. Dine in / take out is asked only once (02); changing it means starting over.
• If checkout finds an order saved on the device without a dine-in / take-out choice, it sends the customer back
to the kiosk home page to choose it (the dishes are kept).
• Estimated preparation time = longest dish + 1 min for each extra serving + 2 min for each order already in the
kitchen (orders/prepTime.ts). It is worked out again when the order reaches the kitchen.
• The print service is a small program on the kiosk's Raspberry Pi (POST http://127.0.0.1:4000/print, printing to
the USB printer); it is not in this repository. Printing never blocks the order.
• QR Ph chosen while PayMongo isn't set up is saved as Pay at counter. Online payment is not set up in production.
